expected._comment: v7.38.25 -- measured at last, same as its Class B sibling. Three runs on an idle testbed, five re-extracted cold samples each: cold medians 3.44 / 3.44 / 3.45 ms (individual samples 3.23-4.98), p50 1.18 / 1.18 / 1.18, p95 1.21 / 1.23 / 1.21. The old cold 300 / warm 200 / p95 250 were 87x-207x that. p50 reading 1.18 three times running is what a hundred samples buys; cold gets more headroom than the ratio suggests because five samples of a millisecond-scale quantity do not.
